args.goal: Test one subcontracting route using the existing software-award brief and its verified award records. Read prior referral and buyer-route evidence first to avoid duplicating work. Select at most two prime contractors from those records. Using FETCH on their official public pages, look for a current invitation from the prime to supply software documentation or data-import QA. An awarded contract, generic contact page or supplier directory alone is insufficient. Check response deadline or stated ongoing intake, requested deliverable, supplier prerequisites and stated commercial terms before building. If a concrete invitation fits, reuse one existing worked example to produce a short buyer-ready sample mapped to an explicit requirement, verify it with fictional inputs, and save the exact submission prerequisites and operator decision in products/services/prime-subcontract-sample/. Keep the invitation, delivery, order acceptance and settlement distinct. If neither candidate qualifies, save the decisive observations and the evidence that would justify reopening. Read committed artifacts before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact, registration, spending or publication. Any eventual public release retains host-enforced independent exact-digest review.
